description: Pass 2 idiom finding under epic PKIX-qwzx. Clippy nursery `doc_link_code` flags four sites where a rustdoc intra-doc link \`[`X`]\` is placed next to backticked plain text. The visible result has a small gap between the linked code and the adjacent code, which looks like a rendering bug. The fix is to wrap the entire group in `...`. Sites: 1. **`pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs:295`** ``` /// `Err(`[`Error::OcspStatusUnknown`]`)` when no matching `SingleResponse` is found. ``` Suggested: `/// Err([Error::OcspStatusUnknown]) when no matching SingleResponse is found.` 2. **`pkix-ac/src/lib.rs:127`** ``` /// [`Error::AaPathInvalid`]`(`[`pkix_path::Error::NoTrustedPath`]`)` ``` 3. **`pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs:33`** ``` //! - At most `1 + `[`MAX_INTERMEDIATES`]` ` certificates (... ``` 4. **`pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs:274`** ``` /// Chain has more certificates than `1 + `[`MAX_INTERMEDIATES`]. ``` These are pure-cosmetic rustdoc rendering improvements. The lint is in `clippy::nursery` (default-allow); no functional impact. Fix: rewrite each per the clippy `--fix` suggestion (use `...` to keep the entire expression as one code block).
